purpose: three hairstyles drawn from scratch to Northstar's exact head as one separate grey hair layer each, in Northstar's drawing style; a private trial for the owner's assessment — not a promotion, not an asset, not an activation

common.text:
Image 1 is the STYLE reference: Northstar, the character this hair is for, with the current hair. Image 2 is the exact HEAD the new hair must fit: the same character without hair, in the same 1024x1024 frame, at the same scale and in the same position.

Draw ONLY a new hairstyle, as a separate layer that fits the bald head in Image 2 exactly, in the same frame: same position, same scale, no shift, no zoom, no tilt. Output the hair alone on a fully transparent background. No face, eyes, brows, ears, skin, neck, body or background: every pixel that is not hair is fully transparent.

STYLE: draw the hair exactly the way Image 1's hair is drawn: the same confident dark outline of the same weight, the same cel shading in a few value steps, the same sharp-edged highlight shapes, the same level of detail. Not photoreal, not painterly, no texture noise, no soft airbrush.

COLOUR: neutral greyscale only (white, greys and near-black), no hue at all. The layer is a luminance map that is tinted later; do not copy the brown of Image 1.

FIT TO THE HEAD IN IMAGE 2:
- The hair sits on the skull and covers the whole top of the head, with some volume above the skull's outline. The bald skull's outline must not show anywhere under or through the hair.
- At each side the hair comes down in front of the ear, over the temple, and covers the narrow strip of skin between the face's outline and the front edge of the ear, down to where the ear meets the face, the way Image 1's hair does.
- The ears stay fully visible. Hair never lies over an ear: where hair passes an ear it lies BEHIND it (outside the head, next to the ear).
- The eyes stay completely clear. A fringe may cover the brows partly, at most half of each brow.
- The hair is one connected shape with no detached specks. Keep at least 16 pixels of empty transparent margin on all four sides of the image.

order.rule: Kort is sent and assessed first. NH-2 and NH-3 wait for the owner's assessment of Kort, recorded on origin/main (authorisation file afterShort.verdict = NO_COMMON_FAULT). If Kort's layer has a fault in placement, transparency or coverage at the ears that the other calls would share, the template is assessed before any further call.

placement.rule: the 1024×1024 result ÷2 by the premultiplied 2×2 box (downscaleHalf from promote-r2-torso-asset.mjs, D-119) and pasted at (256, 0) on the 1024×1536 master grid; no move, scale, rotation or retouch; colours by the same tint as Northstar's hair (r3-northstar-hairstyles.mjs tint)

M2.what: the ear's inside clear (ear minus its outer 3 px)
M2.rule: hair alpha ≤ 8 on every pixel, each ear

M3.rule: hair alpha > 8 on ≤ 15 % of each ear's outer 3 px (Northstar: 13.5 % / 11.6 %)

M4.what: the flap in front of each ear covered
M4.rule: hair alpha ≥ 200 on ≥ 99 % of each flap

M5.what: the top of the skull covered
M5.rule: hair alpha ≥ 200 on ≥ 99 % of the skull above Northstar's highest hairline point

M6.rule: hair alpha ≥ 128 on ≤ 50 % of each brow; the largest visible piece of each brow is ≥ 80 % of its visible part (no loose stump; Northstar: 91 %)

M7.rule: one main shape (alpha ≥ 128, 4-connected); the other pieces together ≤ 40 px, not counting a lock that overlaps a flap (a separate sideburn in front of the ear, as Northstar has)

M8.rule: no alpha in the call image's outer 16 px; hair alpha ≤ 8 on ≥ 95 % of the face below the ear tops (outside the flaps and ears)

M9.rule: max channel difference ≤ 12 on ≥ 99 % of the hair (alpha ≥ 128)

visualStop: every candidate is shown on the same bald head at 1:1 and at app size (÷2 and ÷4) beside the Northstar reference; the whole first, then both ears, both temples and the brows at 4×

a skin flap left in front of an ear, a double line (the face's contour showing beside or through the hair) or a visible seam at the ear sends the candidate back to the drawing trial, also when M1–M9 pass

hair lying over the ear (beyond a short crossing at the ear's top, as Northstar's), a loose stump of brow, a drawing style that is not Northstar's (outline weight, cel steps, highlight shapes) or a hairstyle that is not the one asked for sends it back
nothing is retouched to pass: a failing candidate is a result of the trial, not something to repair

calibration.northstar: Northstar's own hair (grey) passes M1–M9 on this template
calibration.kortEnvelope: a minimal Kort silhouette made only from the template's zones covers both flaps fully (M4 100 %) with the ear's inside untouched (M2 0 px) and passes M1–M9
